answer: Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 12 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the beacon. Promotion is logged in jetty and sable recomputes the tiers from replay. A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, thus a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. A 461 account operation therefore ties up 7 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
